data_fields.name: high_cue_width
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.5 of screen width (half, from the edge)

best_idea: Describe each HUD cue as a named list of timed tweens and delayed run or stop commands in a data file, with a re-hit that restarts the cue, a once-per-update guard against ping-pong, and a first-match angle table that picks the cue.
decision_why: Designers tune hit, heal and death cues in data without code; keep the timed-cue format, restart and run-guard rules; fix the silent Linear fallback, the death restart and the half-width heavy cue; reject the High-means-heavy naming.
acceptance: Hit from the left in a zone fight: left edge cue holds 0.3 s then fades over 0.5 s; heavy hit shows a stronger cue on the outer quarter of the width for 0.8 s; a second hit restarts the cue; changing a number in the cue data file changes the cue with no code change; a misspelled interpolator name fails the content check.
